status: Empty research template. No environmental observations, institutional events or legal findings have been entered.
rules: Keep observation, publication and retrieval times distinct; use ISO 8601 with a timezone offset where time is known.
Record unknown or unavailable values explicitly; absence of a record does not establish that an institution took no action.
Calculate a time interval only after its start, endpoint and date precision are defined. An elapsed interval is not itself unlawful delay.
Keep environmental detection, source attribution, causal analysis and the legal assessment separately supported.
Do not compare air-quality indices as if their scales and averaging periods were interchangeable.
Preserve primary source versions and pinpoint references; do not assign a publication date as an observation date.
